status_values.pending: evidence sufficient to decide; awaiting a reviewer
status_values.evidence_incomplete: cannot be decided until the listed evidence is obtained
status_values.approved: a named human reviewer approved one option, with date and rationale
status_values.rejected: a named human reviewer rejected the proposal(s)
status_values.requires_further_review: a reviewer looked at it and asked for more work

rules: Only a human reviewer may set approved, rejected or requires_further_review, and only with reviewer name, designation, review_date, decision and rationale filled in.
The assistant may only create records, add evidence and set pending or evidence_incomplete.
An approved decision changes nothing by itself: metadata or code changes are made afterwards, with backups, and recorded in history.
Decisions affecting answer eligibility of approved documents must also be reflected in the signed approval record (backend/legal_approval.py); this register is not a substitute for it.
Benchmark review (backend/review_import.py) is not legal approval and cannot settle any decision here.

existing_mechanisms.signed_approval_record: backend/legal_approval.py + docs/approval-trust-model.md: one Ed25519-signed record for the whole approved document set, written from LEGAL-REVIEW-HANDOFF.md section 5. No record, key or signature exists. It has no per-provision version or supersession fields.
existing_mechanisms.benchmark_review: backend/review_import.py: retrieval labels only; explicitly 'NOT LEGAL APPROVAL'.
